arguments.command:
cd /workspace/task/scratch && md5sum log.jsonl > /tmp/before.md5 && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json
codes=[];invalid=[]
with open('log.jsonl','rb') as f:
    data=f.read().decode('utf-8')
lines=data.split('\n')
if lines and lines[-1]=='': lines.pop()
for i,l in enumerate(lines,1):
    if not l.strip(): continue
    try:
        o=json.loads(l)
    except Exception:
        invalid.append(i); continue
    if isinstance(o,dict) and o.get('level')=='error':
        codes.append(o.get('code'))
with open('errors.json','w',encoding='utf-8') as f:
    json.dump({"codes":codes,"invalid_lines":invalid},f,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)
    f.write('\n')
EOF
cat errors.json; md5sum -c /tmp/before.md5
